manifest.method: For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per pair and take the arithmetic mean; report the worse (largest) tokenizer mean. Re-run with the public ainglish-measure reference harness. Items are new; form and anchor-position proportions were fixed before scoring.
manifest.analysis_plan: Report the aggregate required by token_delta, while preserving the form/position cell labels so a reader can recompute each conditional delta. Agreement is judged against the named original's registered tolerance, not selected after observing the result.
